claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing charge-cast magic-item pattern can grant access to a spell, but it cannot override the spell's normal DC source with an item-defined fixed DC.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) from it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.target_predicate.has_speed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item narrows the granted spell to a subset of the spell's normal legal targets: only Beasts that have a Swim Speed. The current spell-access surface has no way to add that extra eligibility predicate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: on a Beast that has a Swim Speed
